title: Have a box to have them dropped into.
text: Have a box to have them dropped into.. These were great. My son will not let me read the advise he was given but they were a great addition to the generic cards that everyone buys. These gave others the opportunity to give their own sage wisdom... Or in the case of his friends much comedy relief.
